scope: Exact-byte transport, the single necessary synthetic statistics/structure/serialization gate, and metadata freeze only. No real pretrained-model loading, actual QA capture, weight decomposition, DEV generation or activation is authorized here.
static_findings: add_qa_moment computes uncentered CPU FP32 h.T@h divided by that QA position count and32 QAs, explicitly outside CPU autocast. It does not center h or mix diagnostic QAs into the statistic.

ResponseD symmetrizes the same moment, selects its top200 output directions, computes C=L.T@D and square-root balances the SVD of C with left=L@Uc. The stored factors represent the same projected D in real arithmetic. WeightD is the ordinary rank200 square-root-balanced SVD.

Capture is fixed to the accepted32 statistic and16 diagnostic S1 groups and original target packing. It samples the same at-most64 positions across24 down hooks. Only moments and bounded current samples are retained; no full feature cache or covariance inverse is used.

Both sets of factors are constructed after the32 moment QAs and before the16 diagnostic QAs. The latter perform exactly16*24*2 local readouts, with QA-equal error and target energy recorded separately. These are teacher-input diagnostics, not full-decoder errors.

Carrier retains original gate/up and act_fn but no original down module. Final whole-model state physically uses only two rank200 readout factors at each layer. The unchanged-parameter digest excludes only replaced down/factor weights and verifies all other parameters/buffers survive substitution and reload.

Each complete candidate is saved, main model references released, and a newly constructed factorized architecture strictly reloads the full state. Layout/digest and evaluation-before/after invariance are required, with all parameters frozen and no optimizer or backward path.

Copied parent scores are anchored to the fixed existing VERIFIED and parent files. Actual parent digest, inherited runtime/processor/config sources and every new per-ID prepared input/reference/cap/EOS are checked; old scores are never recomputed.

The unique verifier requires all three complete successful subprocess exits before starting, then exact mandatory phase files, capture/selection/position records, finite decomposition metadata, physical D absence, full counts/reload, resource PID/terminal phase and original token_f1 scoring of200 outputs.

Feasibility is each arm independently meeting every parent domain point floor, with actual complete counts/budgets/integrity. Selection is highest macro among feasible arms, exact tie WeightD. ResponseD need not win to preserve a useful WeightD carrier.

The controller and workers require a separate READY-bound actual-model admission, use the first selected genuinely free OLD GPU across phases, and apply1200/1800/1800 model-second deadlines with own UID/startticks/isolated-PGID reclamation only.

The synthetic source checks QA-equal accumulation with unequal position counts, the same projected-D factor identity, physical down absence, actual serialized strict whole-Qwen reload and unchanged parent/no gradients. No source execution occurred during this review.
limitations: No confirmed CPU gate or actual-model result exists yet. The reviewer parsed/read source and hashed small files only; no Torch, model, QA, score, bootstrap or activation was executed.
A tiny CPU FP32 pass cannot certify actual CUDA FP16 numerical behavior, large-model timing/memory, whole-model answer fidelity, or subsequent continual readout plasticity.

Keeping G/U preserves their map only at a given layer input; earlier changed D outputs can alter later inputs. Local diagnostic errors cannot authorize a carrier without the actual whole-model F1 floor.

The77,070,336-byte moments cover only those tensors. Current samples, full parent, decompositions, factors, visual cache and other process allocations are additional; no inference-memory or speed claim follows.

The816728096 complete coefficients per arm remain expected until real layouts verify them. Include frozen base/vision/projector/word weights, required weight buffers and shared-storage deduplication, with ordinary buffers/container costs separately reported.

Known SVD and response-aware tools are legitimate carriers/controls; their prior existence does not reject this experiment. A successful carrier alone is not a new framework, a strong-trained-baseline victory, or permission to add continual training.

Explored DEV, one seed and20 QA/domain do not support statistical stability/noninferiority/equivalence. Two failures close the fixed down-only point without rotating matrices, changing rank/data/recovery or reopening old branches.
